patch.rationale: Analyst uses 9-10 paging calls via trip_history/list_trip_outcomes/trip_documents/search_notes for aggregate counts and hits step/call limits; one aggregated read is safe and avoids limits

reasons: no measurable improvement on the problem

patch.text: For weekday or other custom breakdowns with no dedicated tool: call describe_tables once, then use ONE SELECT with GROUP BY in SQL; do not loop per day or try other tools first.
patch.rationale: Both limit_hit traces explicitly ask for read-only weekday on-time % and hit step limit, likely from trying other tools or per-day loops. Hint enforces 2-step path: describe_tables once + single aggregated SELECT.

patch.text: For totals/counts/trends over a date range (e.g. damaged or returned quantities): call describe_tables once, then answer with ONE aggregated SELECT; do not page through per-trip or per-order tools.
patch.rationale: Analyst uses 9-10 paging calls via trip_history/list_trip_outcomes/trip_documents/search_notes for aggregate counts and hits step/call limits; one aggregated read is safe and avoids limits

reasons: no measurable improvement on the problem

patch.text: For weekday or other custom breakdowns with no dedicated tool: call describe_tables once, then use ONE SELECT with GROUP BY in SQL; do not loop per day or try other tools first.
patch.rationale: Both limit_hit traces explicitly ask for read-only weekday on-time % and hit step limit, likely from trying other tools or per-day loops. Hint enforces 2-step path: describe_tables once + single aggregated SELECT.
